business_problem: Ausolan's financial and operational data lived in disconnected systems, which slowed budgeting and analysis and made it hard to react quickly in a competitive catering and cleaning-services market.
solution_summary: Ausolan worked with Saima Solutions and IBM to modernize planning and budgeting with IBM Planning Analytics. The goal was to replace disconnected financial and operational views with a single planning environment that could support analysis, forecasting and resource optimization across the business. Planning Analytics serves as the central modeling and planning layer, consolidating data that had previously been managed in separate tools and making it possible to adjust forecasts as market conditions change. Rather than only speeding up budgeting, the implementation gives managers a shared analytical base for performance control, helping them evaluate operating trends and make more timely decisions about cost, resources and demand. By unifying planning on one platform, Ausolan turned planning from a static periodic exercise into a more agile process that better reflects the pace of its service operations.

solution_components.name: IBM Planning Analytics
solution_components.role: Unifies Ausolan's financial and operational planning, budgeting and forecasting into one adaptive analytical environment.

data_flow: Financial and operational data from previously disconnected systems is consolidated in IBM Planning Analytics, where it is modeled for budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis before managers use the outputs to adjust plans.
business_outcome: Ausolan reduced the time spent consolidating and budgeting data and improved its ability to react to market fluctuations with more flexible forecasting and stronger operational visibility.
metrics: Significantly reduced time spent on data consolidation and budgeting
architecture_clues: The implementation connects financial and operational planning instead of treating them as separate cycles.
Forecast modeling was a core requirement because of market volatility in services.
Saima Solutions participated alongside IBM in the rollout.
